GoGrape redirects to transportation information. Evvnt independent verification remains incomplete; no unverified Evvnt candidates imported.

Withheld Flora & Fauna October 11 candidate: detail page contradicts itself with March course dates. River Run October 7 candidate also has conflicting weekday language. SINGO, Waterhawk line dancing and Dan Durkin detail pages failed; no additions based on failed pages.
No newly confirmed cancellations or postponements among checked information. Prior Gables and Ross Street conflicts remain unresolved; no change inferred from absence on a calendar.

All eight Finley blocks, Balletto dates, Battaglini, October 13 Jewish Film Festival, styling, favicon, search normalization, source panel and other retained event blocks preserved. Each of ten month headings occurs once; actual count, displayed count and summary total match. Search tested.
